title: Heaven Keeps an Accurate Record of Your Good Deeds
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the incredible truth that God sees and records every act of kindness, compassion, and sacrifice you make for His sake, and that He is holding a reward for you that's waiting in heaven. You'll be encouraged to remember that even the smallest details of your life are not overlooked by God, and that He's working to transform you into a giving, loving person who looks beyond yourself. Join Pastor Chris as he shares a message that will challenge and inspire you to live with a heart full of faith and a hope for eternity.
